title: The Great Hunt
author: Robert Jordan
summary: The second book of a sprawling fantasy series. A hunt begins across several lands for a legendary horn, while a young man still reeling from a prophecy about him struggles to control a power he doesn't want.
readIf: you like a big, traditional fantasy series with a widening cast and lots of world-building.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, because it assumes you already know the main cast.

pairings.reason: The first book of the same series, worth reading first because this one picks up straight after it.
A modern epic with a similar scale and a slow build toward huge, intertwined stakes.
Equally long and political, with a harder edge and a much less certain fate for its heroes.
